introduction.summary: This specification records the project purpose, stakeholder constraints and unresolved decisions stated in the source evidence below.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-001
items.detail: Design a secure access-control and network-monitoring system for university research laboratories containing sensitive equipment and research data.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-002
items.detail: The system should allow only authorized students, faculty, researchers, and lab administrators to access designated lab networks and systems based on role and approved permissions.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-003
items.detail: Administrative users should be able to grant or revoke access, review active sessions, monitor unusual login activity, and receive alerts for repeated failed authentication, unauthorized access attempts, and access outside approved lab hours.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-004
items.detail: The system should maintain audit logs of access decisions and administrator actions, isolate research lab networks from general student and guest networks, and support both university-managed and approved research devices.

items.title: Stakeholder source statement E-005
items.detail: The solution should be secure, reliable, and manageable across multiple research buildings.
